ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and refer the driver's account to Ryde for review of the false arrival confirmation + flag_account.
ruling.reasoning: The driver cancelled and claimed no-show, so the fee's validity runs through NS-0's cancelled_by = driver branch into NS-1/NS-2 [F3][NS-0]. The trace settles the elements: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5] and the GPS trace covers the wait without a hole [F5][NS-1]. But NS-1 (ii) fails — at the moment of the tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup (closest approach over the whole trip 599 m, never inside 200 m) [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails — he stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap, against the >180 s requirement [F5][NS-1]. The driver's own message "I'm here already" [F8] is contradicted by the GPS record, and his post-trip statement that he waited at the pickup [F12] is contradicted by the same record; system records override statements [F1][F2][F5][NS-1]. Since the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him away from the pickup, NS-2 requires the $6.61 to be refunded in full and additionally sends the account to Ryde review for abuse of the arrival button [F1][F5][NS-2]. The rider's own account is consistent with the GPS — she said she was at the pickup point and saw no car [F9] — and nothing in the record suggests she acted in bad faith [F16]. The SAFE-1 screen: I read all three chat messages [F8][F9][F10], the driver's statement [F12] and the complaint — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the messages are a factual dispute about location and a statement of intent to cancel [F8][F9][F10][F12]. Finding: none. The traffic facts (Jalan Besar band 3, no incidents) and the weather are irrelevant to a no-show fee and are not used [F13][F14][F15]. Evidence is sufficient: the GPS trace and timeline settle every element NS-2 needs (position at tap, continuous wait, who cancelled) [F1][F2][F3][F5]. Rider's 90-day dispute history (0 of 0) plays no part in the ruling, and the driver's profile likewise cannot decide it — the flag rests on the fake arrival confirmation alone [F16][F17][NS-2].
